method.fixture: Fixed synthetic one-page LuaLaTeX article; fresh browser process/profile per trial; trials run serially with mode order rotated each repetition.
method.startup: Navigation until Import ZIP is visible. Collection setting exists before startup. Remote export connects through the actual diagnostics UI after startup, so startup compares off versus local instrumentation only.
method.compile: UI click until successful compiler result and visible PDF canvas; includes Playwright dispatch/poll and PDF readiness. Cold worker, two warm builds and one offline reload/build per trial. Compiler-reported duration is recorded separately.
method.transfer: Actual uncompressed asset HTTP response body bytes written by the loopback server; sampled cumulatively at phase boundaries, including in-flight responses. Excludes headers/TLS/compression. Export body bytes count attempted browser POST payloads separately, not network headers or downstream OTLP volume.
method.memory: Linux browser process tree, sampled every 250 ms; reports observed RSS and PSS peaks per phase. RSS double-counts shared pages; PSS apportions them. Peaks are lower bounds; phases shorter than 250 ms can have no sample. Not JS heap, worker-only memory, exact maxima, or native collector memory.
method.offline: Both browser context and asset server refuse the network during reload/build. Local collection remains selected; tab-scoped remote credentials are intentionally not restored after reload.
method.limits: Headless Linux desktop, loopback network, one synthetic article and three repetitions by default. OS file cache is warm/shared across trials. No mobile, internet latency, memory-allocation attribution, native overhead, or statistical-significance claim. Browser driver and sampler overhead are present in all modes.
